title: 峨眉山月歌
titleEn: Song of the Moon over Mount Emei
author: 李白
intro: A half moon over Mount Emei, its reflection floating down the river with the boat: young Li Bai is leaving his home province for the first time, and the moon he can no longer see becomes the friend he misses.
analysis: 这首诗写李白第一次离开家乡四川，坐船顺江东下。秋夜，峨眉山上挂着半个月亮，月影映在平羌江里，随着江水一起流动——好像月亮也陪着他走。第三句一口气写出行程：夜里从清溪出发，向三峡驶去。到最后一句，船进入两岸高山的峡谷，再也看不见那轮月亮了，诗人心里很想念，只好继续往渝州去。“君”可以理解为月亮，也有人认为指家乡的朋友，其实月亮正是家乡和友人的化身。短短四句用了五个地名（峨眉山、平羌江、清溪、三峡、渝州），读起来却一点也不堆砌，反而让人感到船行得很快，离家越来越远。
analysisEn: Li Bai wrote this as a young man leaving his home in Sichuan for the first time, sailing down the river at night. A half moon hangs over Mount Emei on an autumn evening, and its reflection drops into the Pingqiang River and flows along with the water — as if the moon were travelling with him. The third line covers the journey in one breath: setting out from Qingxi by night, heading for the Three Gorges. In the last line the boat enters the gorges, where high cliffs hide the sky; he can no longer see “you,” and must go on towards Yuzhou missing it. “You” (君) can be read as the moon, or as a friend back home — either way the moon stands for home and the people he is leaving. Remarkably, these four short lines contain five place names: Mount Emei, the Pingqiang River, Qingxi, the Three Gorges and Yuzhou. Instead of feeling crowded, they give a sense of speed: the boat races on, and home falls further and further behind.
background: Li Bai (701–762) grew up in Sichuan. He is said to have written this around 725, aged about 24, when he set off down the Yangtze to see the wider world.
pronunciation: 平羌江：羌 qiāng。夜发：发 fā（出发）。渝州：渝 yú。
version: 采用统编语文教材文本。

lines.py: é méi shān yuè bàn lún qiū
lines.lit: Over Mount Emei, the moon — half a wheel, autumn;
lines.en: A half moon of autumn hangs over Mount Emei;

lines.py: yǐng rù píng qiāng jiāng shuǐ liú
lines.lit: its reflection enters the Pingqiang River and flows with the water.
lines.en: its image falls into the river and drifts along with me.

lines.py: yè fā qīng xī xiàng sān xiá
lines.lit: At night I set out from Qingxi towards the Three Gorges;
lines.en: By night I leave Clear Creek for the Three Gorges —

lines.py: sī jūn bù jiàn xià yú zhōu
lines.lit: missing you but not seeing you, I go down to Yuzhou.
lines.en: missing you, unable to see you, I sail on down to Yuzhou.

words.note: 今天仍是四川名山，佛教圣地。

words.en: half a wheel — a half moon
words.note: “轮”是月亮的量词，像车轮一样圆；今天还说“一轮明月”。
这里点明季节，也带出清冷的秋意。
这里指月亮在水中的倒影。
今青衣江，在峨眉山东北。
地名，清溪驿，在今四川犍为一带。
一说指长江三峡，一说指乐山附近的小三峡。
古代对人的尊称；这里多理解为月亮，也有说指友人。
顺流而下叫“下”，今天还说“下江南”。
今重庆，简称“渝”就来自这里。

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 峨眉山月是家乡的月亮，一路相伴；看不见它，就是离家越来越远。
imagery.en: The moon over Mount Emei is the moon of home, keeping him company; losing sight of it means home is slipping away.

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 峨眉山代表家乡；三峡的高山遮住了月亮，也隔开了故乡。
imagery.en: Mount Emei stands for home; the cliffs of the gorges hide the moon and cut him off from it.

imagery.name: 江
imagery.zh: 江水载着月影和小船一路东流，写出旅程的快和离别的不舍。
imagery.en: The river carries the moon’s reflection and the boat eastwards, giving both the speed of the journey and the pull of leaving.
